## 中文原文
你白天在家陪宝宝，宝宝玩着玩着开始揉眼睛、打哈欠，看起来困了。你把他抱到婴儿床上，拉上窗帘，调低房间亮度，轻轻拍着他哄睡。没过一会儿，宝宝就安静地睡着了。

## My translation
I stayed home with my baby today. After playing for a while, he started to rub his eyes and yawn, looking tired.
So I put him onto the baby bed, closed the curtain, turned down the light of the room, then got him into sleep with quiet pat.
Just for a while, my baby was asleep quitely.

## Revised version
I stayed home with my baby today. After playing for a bit, he started rubbing his eyes and yawning - he looks sleepy.
I put him in his crib, closed the curtains, dimmed the lights, then patted him softly to sleep.
It didn't take long before he drifted off.

## Key phrases
- rub his eyes，揉眼睛
- yawn，打哈欠
- crib，婴儿床
- dimmed the lights，调暗灯光
- patted him softly to sleep，轻拍入睡
- drift off，慢慢睡着，适合描述小宝宝轻轻入睡
